_about: 400: malformed PAN (too short, wrong format). For external callers Isomorph's schema check rejects this before the action runs — nothing is logged. For builder calls (which bypass that check) the action's own validation catches it and logs an action-refusal entry with outcome: null (see contract §7.4, two-path rule).

response.message: PAN format is wrong: must be 10 characters — 5 uppercase letters, 4 digits, 1 uppercase letter.
